## A. Fixation of Pay on deputation  
A Government servant drawing the pay of t 92,700 in Pay Level 10 is deputed to a post in Level 11 within the same station from 1-4-2023. Fix his Pay on deputation-  
| (a) If he opts to draw his Pay in the ex cadre post. | ~ |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| Pay in Level 10 | 92,700 |
| Pay after adding increment in Level 10 | 95,500 |
| Pay in Level 11 at a stage equal to or next higher | 96,600 |
